# Freckles Beauty Clinic

> Freckles Beauty Clinic is Middlesbrough's longest-established beauty and skincare clinic, operating from 308 Linthorpe Road since 2004. The clinic specialises in laser hair removal (AW3® medical-grade laser), CACI non-surgical facials, Dermalogica skincare treatments and Pro-A AI skin analysis, alongside waxing, brows, lashes and an O.P.I nail spa. Rated 5 stars from 106 Google reviews.

Key facts:

- Address: Freckles Beauty Clinic, 308 Linthorpe Road, Middlesbrough, TS1 3QX, United Kingdom
- Phone: 01642 890111
- Email: info@frecklesbeautyclinic.co.uk
- Online booking: https://www.phorest.com/salon/frecklesbeautyclinic/book/service-selection
- Opening hours: Tue & Wed 9:30am–5:30pm; Thu & Fri 9:00am–7:00pm; Saturday 9:00am–4:00pm; Sunday & Monday closed
- Team: Phillippa (clinic owner, authorised CACI practitioner since 2002, trained directly by CACI) and Katy (senior therapist, CACI practitioner since 1999, trained directly by CACI)
- Authorised CACI clinic, certified Dermalogica clinic and AW3® authorised laser clinic
- Serves Middlesbrough and the wider Teesside area, including Marton, Coulby Newham, Acklam, Ormesby, Nunthorpe and Stockton

## Treatments

- [Pro-A AI Skin Analysis](https://frecklesbeautyclinic.co.uk/skincare): AI skin scanner that identifies sun damage, dehydration, pigmentation and ageing beneath the skin's surface; free with every consultation
- [Laser Hair Removal](https://frecklesbeautyclinic.co.uk/laser): Permanent laser hair removal using the AW3® Flash Combo System, suitable for all skin types; IPL skin rejuvenation, acne therapy and tattoo removal also available
- [CACI Non-Surgical Facials](https://frecklesbeautyclinic.co.uk/caci): Non-surgical face lifts, Synergy toning, Radiance facials and Signature treatments with no needles and no downtime
- [Dermalogica Skincare](https://frecklesbeautyclinic.co.uk/dermalogica): ProSkin 60 and ProSkin 30 facials guided by AI skin analysis, targeting acne, pigmentation, ageing and dehydration
- [Beauty Treatments](https://frecklesbeautyclinic.co.uk/beauty): Waxing, eyebrow shaping, and brow and lash tinting
- [O.P.I Nail Spa](https://frecklesbeautyclinic.co.uk/opi): O.P.I ProSpa manicures, pedicures and gel polish
